name: dia-text-reveal

frames.best_why: A bright blue-purple band is caught sweeping across the new word as it appears.

tagline: A colour band wipes across a rotating word in a headline.
summary: A heading whose trailing word changes between phrases while a multicoloured band sweeps across it, revealing each new word with a brief rainbow shine.
appearance: The words Crafted with in bold white, followed by a single word on the same line. While a word appears, its letters are painted by a travelling band of pink, red, amber, lilac and blue.
behaviour: A gradient band slides left to right over the trailing word, uncovering it in colour; once past, the word rests in plain white, then fades out and the next phrase is revealed the same way.
demo_content: The heading Crafted with precision, then purpose, then passion.
search_phrases: word that changes in a headline
text reveal with a light bar
use_when: A rotating tagline word should get a flash of colour each time it appears.
avoid_when: Quiet editorial pages; the repeated colour sweep is loud and draws the eye.
customise: Pass text as a string or array and set colors, textColor, duration, delay, repeat and fixedWidth; the band width and sweep easing are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One animated span with a moving CSS gradient; only the word width is tweened.

a11y.note: Reduced-motion is honoured by skipping the sweep, but the changing word is not announced to screen readers.

issues: Between phrases the changing word disappears completely, leaving an empty gap beside the heading.
polish_why: A lively, well-timed colour sweep; the blank gap between words is a little jarring.
title: Dia Text Reveal
